description: Base cloud images for the local KVM VM lab (scripts/vm/lab.sh). One pinned Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 image is the supported default; the kernel-matrix entries are placeholders until their sha256 values are pinned and boot-validated.

verification.description: scripts/vm/lab.sh bootstrap refuses to download an image whose sha256 is null or does not match the recorded value. Every up/run boot re-hashes the cached base image before creating an overlay.
pin_steps: Pick an immutable vendor build directory. Ubuntu cloud images are published once per build under https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/<release>/release-<YYYYMMDD>/ and never rewritten; do not pin the moving release/ or current/ paths.
Read the vendor checksum manifest next to the image (listed per entry as checksum_manifest) and copy the expected hash for the exact file name.
Download the image over HTTPS, verify it against the manifest (sha256sum -c for Ubuntu and Fedora, sha512sum -c for Debian) and, for Debian/Fedora, record sha256 of the verified file in this file.
Set status to pinned and run scripts/vm/lab.sh bootstrap --image <name>; the script re-downloads nothing and re-verifies the hash.
Boot it with scripts/vm/lab.sh up --image <name> and set boot_validated to true only after a successful SSH smoke run.
notes: Ubuntu hashes were cross-checked against the SHA256SUMS manifest of the same dated build on 2026-11-13.
Debian publishes SHA-512 manifests (SHA512SUMS), Fedora publishes a PGP-signed CHECKSUM file; both are authoritative but need one translation step to the sha256 field used here.
The URLs below are the ones the lab will fetch; a mirror may be substituted by editing url and re-pinning the hash.

ubuntu-24.04.notes: Default lab image and the only boot-validated entry. Booted on host massive 2026-11-13 via scripts/vm/run-smoke.sh: Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS cloud image, kernel 6.8.0-147-generic, /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux 6103569 bytes, cloud-init DataSourceNoCloud, smoke 4/4 PASS. Build: 20261017 (release.20260926.20261017).

ubuntu-22.04.notes: Kernel matrix entry: 5.15 GA kernel. Hash pinned but not yet booted by the lab; enable in the matrix batch after validating ubuntu-24.04.

debian-12.pin_hint: Debian only publishes SHA-512 manifests. Download the image, run sha512sum -c with the manifest, then set sha256 to sha256sum of the verified file. The latest/ URL moves; pin a dated build from https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/ if the hash changes.
debian-12.notes: Kernel matrix entry: 6.1 kernel. cloud-init NoCloud is supported by Debian generic cloud images; the default user is debian but the lab seed creates fleet with the ephemeral key.

debian-13.pin_hint: Same pinning procedure as debian-12: verify SHA512SUMS, then record the sha256 of the verified qcow2 here.

fedora-42.checksum_manifest_format: PGP-signed SHA256 CHECKSUM file (import the Fedora release key to verify the signature, or trust the HTTPS mirror)
fedora-42.pin_hint: Record the sha256 from the CHECKSUM file after verifying the download; if download.fedoraproject.org redirects to the archive, use archive_url and re-pin.
fedora-42.notes: Kernel matrix entry: 6.14 kernel. Fedora 42 is past its upstream support window as of 2026-11, so the release tree may move to archive.fedoraproject.org and mirror availability can change; for new work prefer the current Fedora release and add it as a new entry.

ubuntu-24.04-arm64.notes: Kernel matrix entry for arm64: same 24.04 build as the x86_64 default. Requires an aarch64 host with KVM; the x86_64 lab host downloads only images whose arch matches, so this entry is inert here.
